title: Stale-While-Revalidate Cache
description: Return cached data immediately while refreshing it in the background.
requirements: If data is stale but present, return it and trigger refresh.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: function createSWR(fetcher,ttl){const cache=new Map();return async key=>{const item=cache.get(key);if(item&&Date.now()-item.time<ttl)return item.value;if(item){fetcher(key).then(value=>cache.set(key,{value,time:Date.now()}));return item.value;}const value=await fetcher(key);cache.set(key,{value,time:Date.now()});return value;};}

title: Async Pipeline with Backpressure
description: Process an async iterable while limiting in-flight transforms.
requirements: Do not allow more than limit unresolved transformations.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: async function* mapConcurrent(iterable,fn,limit=2){const pending=new Set();for await(const value of iterable){const p=Promise.resolve(fn(value));pending.add(p);p.finally(()=>pending.delete(p));if(pending.size>=limit)yield await Promise.race(pending);}while(pending.size)yield await Promise.race(pending);}

title: Build a Middleware Chain
description: Implement middleware composition similar to next().
requirements: Each middleware receives context and next.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: function compose(middleware){return async ctx=>{let index=-1;async function dispatch(i){if(i<=index)throw new Error('next() called multiple times');index=i;const fn=middleware[i];if(!fn)return;await fn(ctx,()=>dispatch(i+1));}await dispatch(0);};}

title: Implement Schema Validator
description: Build a validator for required string/number fields.
requirements: Return a list of validation errors.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: function validate(obj,schema){const errors=[];for(const [key,rules] of Object.entries(schema)){const value=obj[key];if(rules.required&&(value===undefined||value===null||value===''))errors.push(`${key} is required`);if(value!==undefined&&rules.type&&typeof value!==rules.type)errors.push(`${key} must be ${rules.type}`);}return errors;}

title: Build a Worker Retry Queue
description: Create a queue that retries failed async jobs and records final failures.
requirements: Support max retries and return success/failure records.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: async function runQueue(jobs,worker,maxRetries=2){const results=[];for(let i=0;i<jobs.length;i++){let error;let success=false;for(let attempt=0;attempt<=maxRetries;attempt++){try{results[i]={ok:true,value:await worker(jobs[i])};success=true;break;}catch(e){error=e;}}if(!success)results[i]={ok:false,error};}return results;}

title: Build a Dependency Graph Resolver
description: Resolve nodes in dependency order and detect cycles.
requirements: Return a topological ordering or throw on a cycle.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: function topoSort(graph){const state=new Map(),out=[];function visit(node){if(state.get(node)==='visiting')throw new Error('Cycle');if(state.get(node)==='done')return;state.set(node,'visiting');for(const dep of graph.get(node)??[])visit(dep);state.set(node,'done');out.push(node);}for(const node of graph.keys())visit(node);return out;}

title: Implement Rate-Limited Batch Fetch
description: Fetch many keys with concurrency and per-key retry.
requirements: Return results aligned to the input keys.
constraints: Keep the solution focused on the requested behavior.
solutionCode: async function batchFetch(keys,fetcher,{concurrency=3,retries=2}={}){const results=new Array(keys.length);let next=0;async function worker(){while(true){const i=next++;if(i>=keys.length)return;let last;for(let a=0;a<=retries;a++){try{results[i]=await fetcher(keys[i]);last=null;break;}catch(e){last=e;}}if(last)results[i]={error:last};}}await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(concurrency,keys.length)},worker));return results;}
